import Mathlib

/-- Coarse scaling: n·F(M) ≤ m·F(N) + 2m + 2n where F_{u,v}(T) counts integers ≤T coprime to u,v. 
    Key steps: nM − mN < m (from Euclidean division), and η bounds give the +2m+2n slack. -/
theorem coarse_scaling (m n g u v : ℕ)
    (hg : 0 < g) (hu : 0 < u) (hv : 0 < v) (hmn : n < m) :
    (n : ℤ) * ((m/g : ℤ) - ((m/g : ℕ) / u : ℤ) - ((m/g : ℕ) / v : ℤ) + ((m/g : ℕ) / (u*v) : ℤ)) ≤
    (m : ℤ) * ((n/g : ℤ) - ((n/g : ℕ) / u : ℤ) - ((n/g : ℕ) / v : ℤ) + ((n/g : ℕ) / (u*v) : ℤ)) + 2 * (m : ℤ) + 2 * (n : ℤ) := by
  sorry
